wavify.configuration.title: Wavify Config
wavify.configuration.quality.tooltip: One-click quality. Sets render radius, river wave radius and density, and effects amount. Changing any of those by hand switches this to Custom.
wavify.configuration.auto_performance.to: When your FPS drops and Wavify is part of the reason, quietly spawns fewer waves and effects until things recover.
Master toggle for ocean and beach (shoreline) waves. Turn off if you only want river waves, or no waves at all.
wavify.configuration.weather_intensity.t: How much rain and thunderstorms whip up the waves. Storms make waves bigger, faster and more frequent. 0 turns it off.
wavify.configuration.wave_opacity.toolti: How see-through the colored part of the wave is. Lower it to see what is under the waves.
wavify.configuration.foam_opacity.toolti: How see-through the white foam on top of the waves is.
wavify.configuration.biome_color_overrid: Comma-separated biome=color pairs. Use a biome id or a #tag, for example minecraft:lukewarm_ocean=3F76E4,#c:is_cold=3D57D6. Ids win over tags.
wavify.configuration.wave_y_offset.toolt: Moves ocean and shoreline waves up or down. Negative = lower, closer to the water. Going too low hides waves washing up onto the beach.
wavify.configuration.auto_shader_offsets: Uses a tested wave offset for known shader packs (Complementary, BSL, Sildur's, MakeUp, Bliss, Photon, Solas, Rethinking Voxels). Unknown packs use Shader Wave Y Sink.
Darkens the ground where a wave washes up, as if the sand got wet. Turn off to disable the effect entirely.
wavify.configuration.wet_sand_dry_time.t: How long (in ticks) wet sand takes to dry after a wave pulls back. 0 = dries instantly.
wavify.configuration.full_moon_glow.tool: Ocean waves glow at full brightness on full moon nights.
Master toggle for river waves. Turn off if you don't want waves on rivers.
wavify.configuration.river_wave_style.to: CREST: curved crests. STREAKS: thin foam lines along the current. SWELL: soft wide bands. RAPIDS: choppy whitewater. AUTO: picks per spot from river width, depth and current.
wavify.configuration.river_wave_spawn_ra: Radius (in blocks) around you within which river waves spawn. Larger = waves appear further away; smaller = only close by.
wavify.configuration.river_wave_y_offset: Moves river waves up or down. Negative = lower, closer to the water.
wavify.configuration.effects_amount.tool: How many ripples, wakes, mist and slush pieces get spawned. 0 turns them all off.
wavify.configuration.boat_wakes.tooltip: V-shaped foam trails behind moving boats, plus spray at the bow. Works for everyone's boats.
wavify.configuration.entity_ripples.tool: Ripple rings around players and mobs wading, swimming or landing in water.
wavify.configuration.waterfall_mist.tool: Mist, spray and foam rings where falling water lands.
wavify.configuration.rain_ripples.toolti: Little rings on the water surface while it rains.
wavify.configuration.ice_and_slush.toolt: Waves fade out when they reach ice, and snowy oceans get floating slush instead of surf.
